verdict.rationale: Honcho's docs describe Workspaces as top-level containers that isolate different applications or environments (honcho-docs-5). Its own CLI's `honcho start` spins up the full stack (API, deriver, Postgres, Redis) locally via Docker (honcho-docs-10, honcho-docs-9), which gives a first-party way to test without touching production data. There is no documented dedicated sandbox or test mode, so this is environment separation rather than a purpose-built sandbox. Missing for 10: a dedicated sandbox/test environment or test-mode API keys, documented guidance on dev-vs-prod workspace separation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
